observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: A large ornate ballroom with high vaulted ceilings, arched architectural pillars, chandeliers, and red and blue stage lighting, featuring an orchestra on a side stage.
observation.dancers: A large group of young adults dancing in couples.
observation.formation_and_space: Couples spread across a polished wooden floor, rotating and moving in circular patterns together.
observation.posture: Upright, upright torsos with straight backs and engaged core posture.
observation.footwork: Gliding, light stepping patterns matching a steady waltz rhythm, with rapid rotational steps that make precise foot placement partially occluded.
observation.arms_and_hands: Traditional closed ballroom frame with one hand held outward, some dancers holding red roses.
observation.hips_and_torso: Torsos remain upright and relatively still while turning smoothly with the partner.
observation.partnering: Closed dance hold with one hand linked, leading and following rotational movements.
observation.levels_jumps_turns: Continuous spinning turns across the floor with occasional kneeling poses.
observation.costume_and_props: Men wear black tailcoats, white shirts, and bow ties with white gloves; women wear white floor-length evening gowns with long white gloves and hair accessories or tiaras, some holding red roses.
observation.cannot_infer: Precise individual weight transfer and foot positioning are obscured by long dresses and rapid group movement.

signature_moments.what: Couples perform a synchronized rotational turn with arms extended outward, spinning smoothly across the floor.
